stdout:
usage: serialwrap session interactive-open [-h] --selector
                                           SELECTOR
                                           [--owner OWNER]
                                           [--timeout INTERACTIVE_TIMEOUT_S]
                                           [--command COMMAND]
                                           [--allow-attached]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --selector SELECTOR   session_id | COMx | alias
  --owner OWNER
  --timeout INTERACTIVE_TIMEOUT_S
  --command COMMAND
  --allow-attached      允許在 ATTACHED 狀態下開啟 bootloader
                        recovery lease（需通過 bootloader
                        prompt 比對）。 若 session 已有 human
                        interactive lease 則暫停並在 close 時恢復。
